content: If the parameter DoIPVinGIDMaster is set to true and the Container DoIPTriggerGIDSynchronization is configured, the DoIP module shall call the <User>_DoIPTriggerGIDSynchronization function (after successful IP Address assignment, see SWS_DoIP_00204) and repeat this call within the DoIP_MainFunction until its return value equals to E_OK or until the complete connection is closed for any other reason.

If the parameter DoIPVinGIDMaster is set to true and the Con- tainer DoIPTriggerGIDSynchronization is configured, the DoIP module shall call the <User>_DoIPTriggerGIDSynchronization function (after successful IP Address assign- ment, see SWS_DoIP_00306) and repeat this call within the DoIP_MainFunction until its return value equals to E_OK or until the complete connection is closed for any other reason.

If the parameter DoIPVinGIDMaster is set to true and the Con- tainer DoIPTriggerGIDSynchronization is configured, the DoIP module shall call the 25 of 126 Document ID 418: AUTOSAR_SWS_DiagnosticOverIP Specification of Diagnostic over IP AUTOSAR CP R21-11 <User>_DoIPTriggerGIDSynchronization function (after successful IP Address assign- ment, see [SWS_DoIP_00306]) and repeat this call within the DoIP_MainFunction until its return value equals to E_OK or until the complete connection is closed for any other reason.
